2,1,1,2,2,1,2,4,4: Type: 50020 (Text) Name: "Na Bosch, moldamos o futuro por meio das inovações tecnológicas de alta qualidade e de serviços que despertam entusiasmo e melhoram a vida das pessoas. Temos uma promessa sólida para nossos colaboradores: crescemos juntos, gostamos do nosso trabalho e inspiramos uns aos outros. Junte-se a nós e sinta a diferença." LocalizedType: "text"

" LocalizedType: "text"
2,1,1,2,2,1,2,4,8: Type: 50020 (Text) Name: "As a Mid-to-Senior Product Designer, you will be the champion of user-centered design, shaping the future of Bosch Digital products, services, and solutions. You will own the design journey from early-stage context mapping and user research down to high-fidelity prototyping, testing, and implementation." LocalizedType: "text"
2,1,1,2,2,1,2,4,9: Type: 50020 (Text) Name: "Besides your skill in research, service and visual design, we need a strategic thinker who bridges the gap between complex software/system architectures, business goals, and real-world user expectations. Utilizing an iterative Build-Measure-Learn feedback loop, you will turn complex user workflows into highly intuitive, accessible, and delightful digital experiences." LocalizedType: "text"

2,1,1,2,2,1,2,4,13: Type: 50020 (Text) Name: "Iterative End-to-End Design: Guide the product through the complete UX lifecycle (research, wireframing, detailed interaction design, prototyping, and validation testing) ." LocalizedType: "text"
2,1,1,2,2,1,2,4,14: Type: 50020 (Text) Name: "Conduct User Research & Audits: Observe users in their environments, moderate workshops, map customer journeys, and run UX audits or heuristic evaluations to spot usability pitfalls early." LocalizedType: "text"
2,1,1,2,2,1,2,4,15: Type: 50020 (Text) Name: "Rapid Prototyping: Build both low-fidelity wireframes and interactive, high-fidelity prototypes (e.g., in Figma) to validate concept designs and test user flows ." LocalizedType: "text"
2,1,1,2,2,1,2,4,16: Type: 50020 (Text) Name: "UX Standards: Align design implementations with modern design principles, maximizing ease of navigation and screen clarity." LocalizedType: "text"
2,1,1,2,2,1,2,4,17: Type: 50020 (Text) Name: "Maintain & Scale Digital Solutions: Actively work, expand, and enforce BD product, services and solutions, establishing reusable patterns and ensuring consistency across different applications." LocalizedType: "text"

2,1,1,2,2,1,2,4,22: Type: 50020 (Text) Name: "Cross-Functional Synergy: Work in agile, interdisciplinary teams alongside Software Developers, Frontend/Backend Engineers, Product Owners, and System Architects to ensure technical feasibility and smooth handovers." LocalizedType: "text"
2,1,1,2,2,1,2,4,23: Type: 50020 (Text) Name: "Stakeholder Alignment: Act as a critical interface with both internal stakeholders and external clients to translate customer business requirements into elegant, optimal UX designs." LocalizedType: "text"
